visual_reference.version_limit: Video is v1.0.3; recovered ELF/source used below is v1.0.2. Version-equivalent behavior is not established.

logic_evidence.clear_nonsticky: CharAI::_ClearNonStickyTarget at 0x3d8d70 returns when AI sticky byte +0x4b is nonzero; otherwise it calls AI_SetTarget(null,false) at 0x3d6890 then AI_SyncLastTarget at 0x3d49c4.
logic_evidence.callers: CharAI::_OnAnimStepEnd_Attack at 0x3d3e44 calls ClearNonStickyTarget at 0x3d3f2c on its noncontinued last-step branch and at 0x3d3f88 when the continuation/range gate stops the sequence. The branch also emits source events 0x1b/0x1c as captured in port/level-world/reference/character-animation-ai/reference/original-functions.asm.
logic_evidence.sticky_producers: Character::Ctrl_Click at 0x3addc8 writes sticky=1 at 0x3ae084. HUDControls::Update at 0x41a780 clears it at 0x41a9d8 on the held-attack/no-OOI branch. The Windows Tab target-select input is a deliberate host input adaptation, not this recovered producer.
logic_evidence.explicit_skill_clears: Authored BashDown and GroundSlam Post callbacks call ClearTarget unconditionally; Charge calls it only when not TargetInMeleeRange. These are separate explicit source operations and must continue to clear. See port/level-world/reference/character-skill-state-v4/cast-lifecycle-v46.md.
logic_evidence.current_windows_path: CombatSession::selectedactor resolves only the player ActorState.target_id. In the Windows renderer, 3D ring and HUD target label/HP require a nonnull live selectedactor, and HUD additionally requires successful camera projection. Thus target_id loss and presentation omission are separate observations.
logic_evidence.finish_path: The diagnostic CombatSystem finish/interrupt clears ActorState.target_id during action teardown; the session-level patch retains the manually selected player ActorId through action/combo completion without changing CombatSystem or ActorCombatRuntime.

target_retention_evidence.expected_reusable_behavior: A manual player target remains selected through ordinary attack and combo finish while it remains a live eligible target. Existing explicit source ClearTarget, target death, actor removal, and invalid/ineligible target clearing remain effective. Presentation may hide ring/label for an offscreen target while selection remains set.
uncertainties: The user report did not specify an actor, timestamp, input path, or whether the underlying ActorState.target_id or only the ring disappeared.
